title: test/api.test.js: API Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test suite for the questions board API: empty list, add and list, validation, sorting by votes, and 404 handling.

steps.description: Imports: exports from cloudflare:workers, vitest functions.
Api helper: constructs fetch calls to https://board.test.
Ask helper: POST to /api/questions with JSON body.
BeforeEach: clears questions table for isolation.
First test: starts with no questions, expects 200 and empty array.
Add test: posts a question, expects 201, verifies content, then lists and checks.
Validation: refuses empty and over-280-character questions with 400, accepts exactly 280 with 201.
Sorting: upvotes second question, verifies it appears first in list.
